purpose: Python/Rust parity of the format 8 reader and refresh (tests/test_fixtures.py rebuilds it)
formula: weights[r, j] = ((13 r + 7 j + 5 c) mod 31) - 15 with c the row's context (0 in format 6); bias[j] = 96 + (j mod 7); readout[k] = ((17 k) mod 15) - 7, readout bias 0; dense[i, k] = ((13 i + k) mod 255) - 128; dense bias[i] = (i - 16) 255 x 32; residual[i] = i - 16
